Olivia Nguyen: Heads-up — support ticket about v1 RPC fallthrough surfaced a docs gap. Old v1 SDK auto-falls back to embed_xsmall when model alias missing, which silently changes vector dim. Customer hit mismatch in their index.
Matt Chen: Oof. Do we have a quick repro?
Olivia Nguyen: Yes, repro snippet attached in the ticket: `client.generate({ model: 'text-legacy', input: '...' })` then call `client.embed({ model: 'embed-legacy', input })` — if aliases are gone, embed resolves to `embed_xsmall` (128d) while docs still claim 1536d.
Raj Patel: That sounds like a migration doc fail — we call out model alias changes but not the silent fallback. Need an explicit migration note + code sample showing how to pin the model id.
Sophia Li: Agreed. My worry: lots of customers use our quickstart snippet which doesn't pin model ids. We should update quickstart and add a big warning in the v1->v2 migration guide. :warning:
Olivia Nguyen: Proposed plan: 1) Add a short caveats subsection in migration guide that explains fallback behavior and vector dim risks. 2) Replace quickstart embed snippet with explicit model id. 3) Add a smoke test that runs docs snip to check embedding dim. 4) Add a changelog note and an inline banner on affected pages.
Matt Chen: Sounds doable. I can update the quickstart and add explicit snippet. Example change:
```js
// old (ambiguous)
await client.embed({ input: 'hello' })

// new (explicit)
await client.embed({ model: 'h2o-embed-1536', input: 'hello' })
```
Raj Patel: I'll wire the CI smoke test to run sample embed in staging and verify vector length == 1536. Will open a small PR against devsite-tests repo.
Sophia Li: I'll draft the migration doc paragraph and the banner copy. Draft snippet text: "If you previously relied on model aliases, confirm the embedding model and vector dimensionality after swap; pin model IDs in production."
Olivia Nguyen: Great. Let's track PRs: Sophia (docs PR), Matt (docs/snippets PR), Raj (ci test PR). Assign ETA EOD Thursday?
Matt Chen: EOD Thursday for docs snippet update works. Will include TypeScript and Python variants.
Raj Patel: CI test PR will be WIP by Wednesday, hoping to merge Thursday.
Sophia Li: Docs draft ready for internal review by Wednesday morning. Will add example of failing migration and how to convert an index.
Olivia Nguyen: Also need a short customer-facing deprecation blurb for the support template. I'll draft and send to comms after we merge.

Matt Chen: Link to my draft PR when ready so I can get a quick pass: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/??? (will replace with real PR id)

Sophia Li: Pushed initial migration paragraph to branch `docs/v1-embed-caveat` — awaiting review.
Olivia Nguyen: Thanks everyone. After merges, we'll add an in-page banner like: "Heads up: embedding model aliases may have changed — verify vector dims and pin model IDs."
Matt Chen: Quick reminder: update SDK snippet comments to mention "alias may map to a different dimension; pin to avoid surprises."
Raj Patel: I'll add a flake/guard in CI so the smoke test doesn't fail builds unless flagged by a docs-owner label. Don't want accidental CI noise.
Sophia Li: Tagging @Olivia for final content approval before merge.
Olivia Nguyen: Approved — once PRs are green, I'll sign off on the customer blurb and comms. :+1:

Matt Chen: Thanks — will update link placeholders in the PR once real numbers available.
Olivia Nguyen: Post-merge checklist: update quickstart, migration guide section, changelog entry, support template, and add redirect for any alias-misleading pages.
Sophia Li: Noted. I'll also add a small code snippet for how to check vector length locally:
```py
vec = client.embed(model='h2o-embed-1536', input='test')
assert len(vec) == 1536, f"expected 1536 got {len(vec)}"
```
Raj Patel: Perfect. Closing loop: I'll post the CI result in this thread when done.
Olivia Nguyen: Thanks team — good catch.
